description: "The First Little Pet Book with Ten Short Stories in Words of Three and Four…" by Aunt Fanny is a collection of children's stories written in the mid-19th century. The book is designed for young readers and focuses on simple narratives that utilize primarily three and four-letter words to promote early literacy.
